items.description: McCrispy Strip with shredded lettuce, shredded cheese and new creamy Caesar Sauce (Parmesan, lemon, garlic) in a soft tortilla; part of a four-item Caesar-themed LTO lineup.
McCrispy chicken sandwich topped with bacon and McDonald's new Caesar Sauce; launched with the Caesar LTO lineup (also includes Caesar Sauce dip cup and Caesar-sauced McCrispy Strips).

Warm sleeved pie filled with blueberries and vanilla creme; returned nationwide for summer and expected to leave menus around Sept 1.
Seasonal fall pie with pumpkin and vanilla creme filling; tracked as returning in September, replacing the summer Blueberry & Creme Pie.

Limited-time World Cup promo: choice of Big Mac or 10-pc Chicken McNuggets with gold-packaged Big Mac Sauce, plus 1 of 9 collectible cups featuring soccer stars; companion Happy Meal with 23 Squishmallows plushies.
Collab Happy Meal featuring BT21 (BTS character universe) toys and themed packaging, at participating US restaurants for a limited time.

Seasoned boneless pork rib patty with BBQ sauce, pickles and onions; reported phased rollout starting the last week of October in select Midwest/South markets, most locations early-to-mid November. Not a full nationwide release.
Halloween Happy Meal pails expected back for their 40th anniversary in October; leaked monster designs (witch, vampire, skeleton, werewolf, cat) are unconfirmed by McDonald's.

'Whopper By You' guest-created LTO: flame-grilled beef with crispy-fried jalapeños, pickled jalapeños, creamy jalapeño sauce, lettuce, tomato and American cheese on a sesame bun (~$6.99); headline item of the summer menu.
Fan-favorite LTO back for summer: 1/4 lb flame-grilled beef with melty Swiss, crispy fried pickle chips, bacon, lettuce, tomato and creamy BBQ sauce.
Crispy tots stuffed with melty cheddar cheese, fluffy potatoes and ranch seasoning; returning fan-favorite side on the summer menu.
New frozen drink platform debut: creamsicle-style frozen orange base topped with orange cream cold foam and sprinkles (~$2.99).
Chilled dessert with velvety cream over a crisp sugar cookie crust topped with red, white and blue star sprinkles, celebrating America's 250th birthday (~$2.99).
Crown-shaped chicken nuggets, first launched in 2006, back in King Jr. Meals and as a standalone 8-piece; a Crayola-themed King Jr. Meal followed June 9.

items.item: FIFA World Cup Match Day Bundles
items.description: Limited-time World Cup-themed value bundles tied to the 2026 tournament, available at participating US locations.

Halloween LTO lineup expected back for fall (last year's edition launched Sept 30 with Jack-O-Lantern Whopper on an orange bun, Vampire Nuggets, Mummy Mozzarella Fries and Franken-Candy Sundae); this year's items not yet officially announced. No 2026 return announced yet.

Barbie collaboration lineup of five limited-time refreshers (Ultimate Pink, Double Strawberry, Pink Mango, Pink Cherry, Pink Cherry Protein) topped with Barbie Pink Strawberry Cold Foam, plus a Pink Pineapple Refresher and collectible pink cup.

items.item: Strawberries & Creme Cloud Dunkalatte + Strawberry Cloud Matcha

Yeast shell donut inspired by the rocket pop popsicle: cherry, lime, and raspberry buttercream filling, blue icing, stars-and-stripes sprinkles. Limited-time summer item.

items.item: Golden BBQ Hash Brown Wake-Up Wrap & Loaded Hash Browns
items.description: Limited-time savory items: wrap with bacon, egg, American cheese, hash browns and Golden BBQ sauce; loaded hash browns topped with Golden BBQ sauce and crumbled bacon.
Summer 'Wave 3' drink: tropical blend of mango-pineapple and strawberry-dragonfruit flavors mixed with lemonade; $3 medium Refresher deal for Rewards members through Aug 19.
Summer 'Wave 3' drink: blueberry-forward refresher built on lemonade or green tea base; customizable via the Mix Your Own Refresher feature in the Dunkin' app.

items.item: Fall Pumpkin Lineup (official return date confirmed)
items.description: Dunkin's fall 2026 menu, confirmed via the brand's own Instagram announcement for an Aug 19 pumpkin return; concrete items added separately.

Tiramisu Cloud Latte, Tiramisu Protein Latte, Tiramisu Shakin' Espresso, and Tiramisu Marshmallow Matcha - part of the Aug 19 2026 fall menu. Widely reported by menu trackers as live, though still not backed by a formal Dunkin' press release.

items.item: Chipotle Hash Browns & Maple Sugar Bacon (leaked return)
items.description: Returning savory items (seen in Dunkin's 2024 fall menu) reported as part of the Aug 19 2026 fall menu launch; consistent across sources but not yet confirmed via a formal Dunkin' press release.

Four limited-time summer doughnuts: Key Lime Pie (lime Kreme, graham crunch), Lemon Bar (cookie pieces, lemon swirl), Cannoli Inspired (chocolate icing, cannoli buttercreme), and Original Glazed Strawberry Cake doughnut.
Two limited-edition frozen summer beverages, part of the Summer Seasonal collection at participating U.S. shops.
Destination Dessert collection: unglazed shell doughnut filled with tres leches Kreme, topped with sweet creme buttercreme, cake doughnut crumbs, and cinnamon. Latin American-inspired lineup.
Destination Dessert collection: unglazed shell doughnut filled with cheesecake Kreme and guava filling, dipped in guava icing, topped with icing drizzle and crunch.
Destination Dessert collection: unglazed shell doughnut filled with chocolate dulce cookie Kreme, dipped in chocolate icing and cookie crumbles, topped with dulce de leche buttercreme.

Four fall doughnuts (returning Pumpkin Spice Cake and Biscoff Cookie Butter, new Maple Cheesecake and Cafe Mocha) plus two new lattes (Pumpkin Spice, Apple Crisp), sold individually and by the dozen at participating shops; more seasonal items expected later in August and September.

Fan-voted return: fresh beef on a warm pretzel bun with Muenster cheese, beer cheese sauce, three strips of bacon, crispy onions, pickles, and honey mustard. Part of Wendy's limited-time fall pub menu.
New chicken variant of the pub lineup: crispy chicken on a pretzel bun with beer cheese, bacon, crispy onions, pickles, and honey mustard, launched with the fall pub menu.
Natural-cut fries loaded with beer cheese sauce, bacon, and crispy onions; part of the limited-time fall pub-inspired menu.
Vanilla Frosty blended with spiced apple syrup and oat crumble topping; Wendy's fall 2026 seasonal Frosty dessert, available throughout fall for a limited time.
Classic Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty for $1 as a summer value promo; Wendy's Rewards members got early access July 19 for National Ice Cream Day.
Limited-time supersized Crunchwrap with double layers of beef and cheese, featured on Taco Bell's July/August 2026 limited-time lineup.

Crispy chicken nuggets dusted with Diablo seasoning, one of three LTO nugget flavors (Diablo, Flamin' Hot, Doritos Cool Ranch) in Taco Bell's 2026 slate; paired with new Mike's Hot Honey Diablo sauce.

Slow-roasted chicken and black beans layered between crispy tortillas with green chile sauce, three-cheese blend, cabbage, and pico de gallo, served with new Jalapeño Citrus Salsa; revealed at Live Más Live. Launched nationwide May 21, 2026; no confirmed end date found yet.

Dessert Crunchwrap with creamy vanilla filling, crispy cinnamon-sugar tostada, and a caramelized, crackable cinnamon-sugar crust; part of Taco Bell's 20+ new items announced for 2026. Currently a $1.99 regional test in Grand Rapids, MI; nationwide rollout not yet confirmed.

New strawberry-horchata beverage, one of eight new desserts and drinks in Taco Bell's announced 2026 lineup (alongside the Milk Bar Birthday Cake Empanada collab). Announced at Live Mas Live 2026; not yet on menus.
Passionfruit and guava Refresher with mango-pineapple pearls and butterfly pea flower infusion for a purple hue; headliner of the summer 2026 menu.
Blonde espresso shaken with horchata syrup (cinnamon, vanilla, toasted rice notes) topped with oatmilk, plus a blended Frappuccino version; limited-time summer 2026 items.
Returning Summer-Berry Refresher, Summer-Berry Lemonade Refresher, and Summer Skies Drink, back nationwide for the summer 2026 season.
PSL returns to headline the fall 2026 menu alongside returning pecan drinks (Pecan Cortado, Pecan Crunch Latte, Iced Pecan Crunch Latte).
New chai-apple cider hybrid drink blending apple cinnamon and sweet spice, available hot or iced; debuts with the fall 2026 menu.

items.item: Iced Banana Bread Latte & Iced Banana Bread Chai
items.description: Two new banana bread-inspired iced drinks with banana, cinnamon, and brown sugar flavors, launching with the fall 2026 menu and staying on the menu beyond fall.
Movie tie-in Supergirl Ultimate Meal and Combo Meal with three 'choose your hero' sauces, a Kryptonian Kooler beverage, blind-bag collectibles, and a limited Krypto Collectible Bucket.
Popcorn Chicken back nationwide after a three-year absence: $10 16oz Bucket with four sauces, $10.99 Big Box meal, or $8.49 Combo.
New summer beverage available straight or mixed with Starry or Mtn Dew Sweet Lightning, or as an iced tea; part of KFC's summer 2026 beverage push.
Returning fan favorite on the summer 2026 'Newstalgia' menu, celebrating the chain's 80-year heritage; available for a limited time nationwide.
Seasonal peach treats back nationwide for a limited time as part of the summer 2026 menu.
Returning Pineapple Dragonfruit seasonal drink lineup (lemonade, tea, frosted variants) for summer 2026, limited time; 2026 lineup adds a new Pineapple Dragonfruit & Sprite variant.
New fall 2026 sandwich: boneless chicken breast (original, spicy, or grilled), lettuce, tomato, cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, and Creamy Dijon Mustard Sauce on a buttery pretzel bun.

items.item: Cherry Berry & Sprite + Cherry Berry lineup
items.description: Chick-fil-A's first seasonal soda mixing Sprite with cherry, blueberry, and cranberry flavors, launching alongside the returning Cherry Berry Lemonade, Frosted Lemonade, and Sunjoy for fall 2026.

Two new ridged potato chip varieties shaped like the signature waffle fries — sea salt Original and Chick-fil-A Sauce flavored — debuting nationwide with the fall 2026 menu on Aug. 18 as a permanent side item, on-the-go snack, and catering option (not limited-time). Retail 7-oz bags also rolling out to Publix, Walmart, and Kroger in Georgia, Florida, North and South Carolina, Alabama, Tennessee, Virginia, West Virginia, Kentucky, Ohio, Arkansas, and Missouri starting early October. Now a permanent menu item.

Thin Mints (chocolate icing, chocolate chips, cookie crumbles), Lemon-Ups (Lemon Crisp Kreme filling), and Coconut Caramel doughnuts, at shops and select retailers. Ran July 7-26; kept for the record.
Rewards deal: buy any dozen, get an Original Glazed dozen for $1. Sign up for Krispy Kreme Rewards by Aug 26; offer window runs through Aug 12.

Two smashed Angus beef patties (triple available) with a sweet-and-spicy jalapeno-pineapple glaze, melted pepper jack, bacon, shredded lettuce, and mayo on a toasted potato bun. New for the summer menu; from $8.49.
Pineapple and coconut slush swirled with vanilla soft serve and real pineapple pieces. New limited-time slush on the summer menu.
Returning summer LTO: layers of blue raspberry slush, vanilla soft serve, and strawberries, served in limited-edition cups featuring American landmarks; $2.50 for a 20-oz all summer.
Value combo: Sonic Cheeseburger, small Premium Chicken Bites, medium fountain drink, and choice of medium Tots or Fries for $7. Value Menu also refreshed with a Vanilla Soft Serve Cup.

items.item: Quarter Pound BBQ Menu (Pulled Pork & Chopped Brisket)
items.description: Returning summer BBQ lineup: quarter pound of 4-hour hickory-smoked pulled pork or 13-hour smoked chopped brisket with pickles on a toasted brioche bun, sweet or spicy BBQ sauce. Limited time nationwide.
New: quarter pound of smoked pulled pork or chopped brisket layered over creamy white cheddar mac and cheese, finished with crispy onions and choice of BBQ sauce; ~$8.99-$10.99. Limited time.
Returning summer LTO: pecan chicken salad with diced chicken, red grapes, apples, celery, pecans, and mayo on toasted honey wheat bread (~$8.69). Through late August/early September.
Returning summer LTO inspired by orange cream bars: orange cream-flavored shake topped with whipped cream (~$4.29 small). Through late August/early September.
Grilled, seasoned shaved steak topped with melty Swiss-style cheese, grilled onions and peppers, and mayo on a buttery toasted hoagie roll; from $11.49. Limited time at participating locations.
Seasoned beef grilled and topped with Swiss-style cheese, grilled onions and peppers, and mayo on a buttery toasted bakery bun; single, double, and triple from $4.49. Limited time.
Limited-time $14 late-night box: Philly-Style Double Bonus Jack, two tacos, curly fries, drink, plus one of eight collectible Jibbi bag charms tied to the 75th anniversary.

Fan-favorite fried chicken sandwich from 1980 (retired 2004) back for the yearlong 75th anniversary: crispy chicken with Monterey Jack and Swiss cheeses; combos and Munchie Meal with limited-edition Jibbi charms.
August Blizzard of the Month: cheesecake pieces and caramel apple topping blended with DQ's vanilla soft serve — an early kickoff to fall flavor season.
New fall Blizzard arriving with the fall treat collection: brown sugar cookie dough pieces and brown sugar topping blended with DQ soft serve. Limited time starting Aug 31.
New fall sip: cold brew blended with DQ soft serve and ice, cupscaped with cocoa fudge, whipped topping garnish. Limited time starting Aug 31.
Returning fall classic: real pumpkin pie pieces blended with DQ soft serve, whipped topping and nutmeg garnish. Limited time starting Aug 31.
DQ Rewards members buy one Blizzard and get a second for 99 cents via the DQ App, once per day at participating US locations, Aug 3-30.

Five picks for $5 each: NEW 8-piece Butterfly Shrimp in Louisiana spice breading (also Buffalo, Garlic Parm, Lemon Pepper or Ghost Pepper), Chicken Sandwich, 3pc Signature Chicken, 3 Tenders, or two regular sides (digital exclusive). Combine any two for $10.
Lightly breaded, deep-fried cheese curds served with Blackened Ranch or a dipping sauce of choice; limited-time side for about $3.99.
Limited-time value return: $6 Big Box with 2pc fried chicken or 3 tenders, two sides, and a biscuit. Ran June 2 - July 13, 2026; kept for the record.
Limited-time value return: $20 Family Meal with 9pc chicken or 11 tenders, one large side, and four biscuits.
Limited-time dessert: cheesecake swirled with blueberry lemon filling on a buttery graham cracker crust, about $4.49.

Fan-favorite sweet, tangy Southern BBQ wing flavor with golden mustard-forward taste, back nationwide for a limited time in the Flavor Rodeo. Live for Club Wingstop members since Aug 7; nationwide for all customers Aug 11.
Returning limited-time wing flavor with warm Caribbean spices and savory herbs, part of the Flavor Rodeo lineup. Live for Club Wingstop members since Aug 7; nationwide for all customers Aug 11.
New limited-time dipping sauce launching with the Flavor Rodeo: sweet honey mustard with a fiery hot-honey kick.
Limited-time Coca-Cola collab beverage blending lemon-lime citrus with sweet strawberry; exclusive to Wingstop locations with Coca-Cola Freestyle dispensers. Members Aug 7, all customers Aug 11.

Limited-edition collab with country star Megan Moroney: 24 oz purple rhinestone stainless tumbler, $19.99, in restaurants and online while supplies last; at least $2 per tumbler sold Jul 29-Aug 26 benefits The Megan Moroney Foundation (min. $100,000 guaranteed donation).

Glittery pink limited-time collectors' cup with matching lid and straw, Moroney's signature, and a QR code to her 'Cloud 9' album; add to any Combo or 32 oz drink for a small upcharge while supplies last.

Giant Chicken Finger Wrap with 3 hand-breaded Chicken Fingerz, mixed greens, carrots, red cabbage, Cheddar Jack, bacon, cucumbers, tomatoes and ranch, served with crinkle fries and a drink; limited-time through end of summer.
Made-to-order giant quesadilla packed with 3 hand-breaded Chicken Fingerz, Cheddar Jack, bacon and ranch on a flour tortilla; limited-time through end of summer.
Crinkle fries topped with hand-breaded fried chicken, Cheddar Jack, bacon and ranch; limited-time through end of summer.
Hand-spun banana pudding milkshake blended with vanilla wafer pieces, topped with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry; back since May and offered for a limited time.
Fan-favorite 'swicy' protein returns: grilled chicken marinated with smoky chipotle peppers and finished with pure honey. In bowls, burritos, quesadillas, salads and tacos for a limited time.

Three-month gamified rewards program: opted-in Rewards members earn free entrees (7 entree purchases in a month = free entree or 1,625 points), streak badges, and local/state/national superfan rankings through August.

Chipotle's collaboration with Riot Games' fighting game 2XKO has two components: (1) the 'Real Ones Event' branded in-game lobby with limited-time missions, which ran in two phases (June 16-28 and July 21-Aug 6) and has concluded; and (2) a separate TAGTEAM promo-code offer still running — buy a regular-priced entree via the Chipotle app/site to earn a code for the in-game 'Chipotle Fresh Fit Bundle' (backpack + bucket hat, capped at 40,000 codes). The code-earning window runs through 8/28/26 or while supplies last, with in-game redemption allowed through 9/15/26.

Nostalgia-themed limited-time menu: $3 Personal Pan Pizza, $10 Medium Stuffed Crust, $4 Breadsticks, $4 Cinnamon Sticks, plus new Triple Cheese Mac and S'mores Sticks — with a matching throwback merch drop.
New $5 dessert: classic breadsticks topped with toasted marshmallows, graham cracker crumbles and chocolate, baked until gooey. Limited time through Aug 30.
New $6 baked mac and cheese: cavatappi with white cheddar, Pizza Hut's signature pizza cheese and parmesan, baked until golden. Debuted with the Throwback menu; staying on as a permanent item.
Limited-time twist on the Original Pan: parmesan layered on the outer crust before baking for a toasty, cheesy crunch. From $10 medium / $13 large (1-topping).

Domino's is 'paying' customers to try its redesigned website and app: any qualifying online order Aug 3-30 earns a $5 coupon for a digital order the following week (Rewards members via 'My Deals', others by email).
Limited-time $3.99 toasted 9-inch tortilla pockets with 20+ grams of protein in four varieties: Baja Chicken, Peppercorn Ranch Chicken, Italian Trio, and Turkey & Ham.
Movie tie-in: upgrade any combo meal for $1 more to get one of five collectible Moana character cups plus a $15 Fandango promo code. Through Aug 19, while supplies last.

items.item: Fresh Value Menu (Deli Faves & Sub of the Day)
items.description: Subway's first-ever nationwide value menu: 15 entrees under $5. 'Deli Faves' offers four customizable 6" subs for $3.99 (BLT, Cold Cut Combo, Spicy Pepperoni, Ham & Salami); 'Sub of the Day' offers a different 6" sub for $4.99 each day of the week. Complements the existing Protein Pockets.

McDonald's first energy drink collab with Red Bull: layered iced McCafe beverage blending Red Bull with blue raspberry flavor, topped with freeze-dried dragonfruit pieces (~80mg caffeine); regular and zero-sugar versions. Early/soft access appeared at some locations around Aug 4-5, but the official confirmed nationwide launch is Aug 17, 2026 per McDonald's/PR Newswire.
Fan-favorite from 2024 returns: slow-roasted chicken or grilled steak with onion and cilantro tucked into a warm, cheesy Quesalupa-inspired shell. Sold two for $5.49, or in a $9 Luxe Cravings Box.

Nostalgic creamsicle-inspired drinks: Orange Cream Cold Brew, Iced Orange Cream Latte, Iced Orange Cream Matcha, Iced Orange Cream Chai, and Orange Cream Frappuccino, plus a Dandy Worldwide merch collab.

items.item: Pumpkin Cream lineup (Iced Pumpkin Cream Shaken Espresso, Chai, Matcha)
items.description: New pumpkin-cream drinks debuting with the fall 2026 menu: Iced Pumpkin Cream Shaken Espresso, Pumpkin Spice Chai, and Iced Pumpkin Cream Matcha.
New protein-forward food item launching with the fall 2026 menu.
New fall-themed cake pop shaped like a hedgehog, launching with the fall 2026 menu.

Crispy seasoned country-fried steak topped with creamy pepper gravy, served with mashed potatoes, coleslaw, and a biscuit; $4.99, Wednesdays only, in-store only. Available in every U.S. state but not at every location.
Refreshed value menu with four items at $1.99 each: Cheesy Baja Crispy Tender Wrap, Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, Vanilla Soft Serve Cup, and Small Root Beer Float.
Frozen versions of Sonic's Mango Peach, Strawberry Passion Fruit, and Berry Citrus Refreshers, plus a new limited-time Watermelon Peach flavor. 20oz intro price $2.99 through May 31.

48-oz 'bucket' filled with a customer's choice of Dunkin' iced coffee or Refresher (e.g. Cherry Lime Rickey Refresher, Pink Pineapple Sparkling Refresher, Iced Coffee with Peanut Swirl), $12.99; companion cup-holder accessory available to Boosted Rewards members online.

Fan-created 'Whopper By You' LTO: quarter-pound flame-grilled beef patty with peppercorn mayo, bacon, lettuce, tomato and American cheese on a sesame bun; also available as Jr., meal, and Impossible variants. Previously missed from earlier tracking.
Flatbread-wrapped fried-shell sliders with steak or chicken and a three-cheese blend; announced as part of Taco Bell's 2026 Live Más Live menu roadmap. No confirmed launch date yet.

Follow-up to the Baja Blast Pie, announced as part of Taco Bell's 2026 Live Más Live menu roadmap. No confirmed launch date yet; early reports point to a winter holidays 2026 debut, following the original Baja Blast Pie's Nov 2025 launch pattern.
Dessert collaboration with Milk Bar, announced as part of Taco Bell's 2026 Live Más Live menu roadmap. No confirmed launch date yet.
Weekly value deal: classic corn dogs for 99 cents every Thursday throughout August 2026.
New choice added to the $7.99 Meat & 3 Value Box: crispy chicken breast with buffalo sauce, ranch, and shredded lettuce on a brioche bun.
Promo code GIDDYUP for $0 delivery fee on qualifying orders, tied to the Flavor Rodeo launch.

First-ever limited-edition sauce: tangy, mayo-based Alabama-style white BBQ, joining Zaxby's signature sauce lineup as a side portion only (no bottles sold); promoted with Alabama native Rob Rausch. Small-batch release available in-restaurant, in the app, and on zaxbys.com — will not be restocked once sold out.

The viral 2017 Unicorn Frappuccino recipe returns for one weekend only: sweet-tart mango blend with tangy blue drizzle, whipped cream, and pink-and-blue topping. Rolling out nationwide (and internationally) Aug 15-16, 2026 to close out summer.

Revived summer reading incentive: pre-K through 6th graders who hit a monthly reading goal in the BOOK IT! app earn a free one-topping Personal Pan Pizza; new for 2026, a Box Tops for Education partnership lets families also earn cash for schools. Runs June 1 - August 31, 2026.
Netflix 'Happy Gilmore 2' movie tie-in meal with collectible cups; ran July-September 2025. No 2026 rerun confirmed.

Four new value sliders under $2 each: Roast Beef Slider (Swiss), Buffalo Chicken Slider (crispy tender, buffalo sauce, ranch), Chicken Slider (crispy tender, Swiss), and Ham Slider (Swiss); promoted with Harry Jowsey and Malin Akerman. Pricing may run slightly higher in CA, CT, NY, OR, WA.

75th-anniversary LTO: 2oz seasoned smashed beef patty with crispy caramelized edges, melty American cheese, pickles, and Smashed Jack sauce on a brioche bun; sold as 3-piece sliders, a Munchie Meal with two tacos and curly fries, or an 8-piece Party Pack. No announced end date.

Swicy mozzarella sticks breaded in a Carolina Reaper-seasoned coating balanced with brown sugar and honey, served with buttermilk ranch, sold alongside the classic version's return. No announced end date.
New value meal built around Popeyes' reformulated hand-battered tenders: 4 tenders (classic, spicy or blackened), a regular side, a regular drink, and a biscuit for $9.99.

items.item: Wing Week presented by Live Nation
items.description: National Chicken Wing Day expanded into a 3-day giveaway with Live Nation: July 29 tickets-for-a-year ($3,000 Ticketmaster gift card), July 30 festival package for two (VIP tickets, airfare, hotel, spending money), July 31 $500 Ticketmaster + $500 Wingstop gift cards. Ran July 29-31, 2026; kept for the record.

Test-market Whopper: quarter-pound flame-grilled beef patty with bacon, an egg patty, cheddar cheese sauce, hash browns and hollandaise aioli on a sesame bun. First spotted Jan 8, 2026 in Raleigh, NC and Portland, OR only; as of early August still not confirmed for nationwide rollout despite fan requests — a regional test, not a national LTO.

Leaked, unconfirmed: an internal-looking menu update spotted on Reddit suggests Arby's is testing a dirty-soda drink line, including a classic Shirley Temple and a coconut-cream "Shirley 'n Cream" Coke, riding the dirty-soda trend seen at McDonald's, Burger King, KFC and Crumbl. Arby's has not confirmed this or given a launch date.

McDonald's "biggest burger yet": two quarter-pound beef patties, three slices of white cheddar, crispy and slivered onions on a sesame-poppy seed bun. Launched nationwide in March; some reports suggest it has since been pulled from certain locations' menus, though McDonald's has not confirmed a nationwide end date.
Pineapple-flavored frozen slush drink, back on the menu for summer 2026 (the 2020 run also had a vanilla-blended Whip Freeze version, not currently offered).

Red flour tortilla burrito with seasoned rice, nacho cheese sauce, seasoned beef, Fiesta tortilla strips, creamy chipotle sauce, reduced-fat sour cream, and a sprinkling of cayenne poppin' crystals for a popping-candy effect; announced as part of Taco Bell's 2026 Live Más Live menu roadmap. No confirmed nationwide launch date yet.
New dessert bundled into the $10.99 Popcorn Chicken Big Box (Popcorn Chicken, 2 tenders, fries, drink, 2 sauces, cookie), launched alongside Popcorn Chicken's nationwide return.

$10 Tuesday expanded into a weekday value lineup: 24 nuggets Mon/Fri, 8pc drums & thighs Tue, 10 wings Wed, 8 tenders Thu; plus two new house sauces, Honey Chili Crisp and Jalapeño Ranch. Weekdays 10:30am-9pm at participating locations, May 5 - Sept 15, 2026.
Thin-sliced Angus steak, melted cheese, peppers and onions on a hoagie roll; graduated from LTO to a permanent core-menu item as of mid-2026.

Chipotle's first-ever High Protein Menu: High Protein Cup, Double High Protein Bowl, High Protein-High Fiber Bowl, High Protein-Low Calorie Salad, Double High Protein Burrito, and Adobo Chicken Taco (15-81g protein per item); expanded in August 2026 with app-exclusive creator/athlete-inspired builds.

Offer opened Aug 5, 2026, with in-store redemption starting Aug 6; each redeemed code expires 14 days after it lands in the guest's account. Burger King has not announced when the text-to-claim window itself closes.

Frozen twist on Starbucks' Energy Refreshers platform: Blended Mango Dragonfruit Lemonade, Blended Mango Strawberry Lemonade, Blended Pink Energy Drink, plus limited-time Blended Passionfruit Guava Lemonade and Blended Matcha Lemonade, made with real fruit pieces, ice, and a choice of lemonade or coconut milk.
Thick-cut, Cajun-battered onion rings spotted at select/test locations (e.g. Miami) at $3.99; no national rollout announced yet.

Hand-cut, breaded crispy chicken (no preservatives, gluten, or artificial ingredients) being tested in bowls, burritos, tacos and salads at a small number of restaurants in Orange County, CA (Tustin, Irvine). Chipotle has confirmed the test but not committed to a broader rollout pending guest and operational feedback.

items.item: Refreshers & Crafted Sodas lineup (incl. Dirty Dr Pepper)

Free small chili via the Wendy's app with any $5+ qualifying purchase.

items.description: Big Bacon Classic or Spicy Chicken Sandwich meal with a blind-box collectible, plus new Banana Frosty Swirl (vanilla Frosty with banana cream sauce); movie tie-in promo.

items.description: White-corn taco with a three-cheese blend and grilled-cheese exterior, served with enchilada dipping sauce; testing only in the Tampa Bay, FL area.

items.description: Marshmallow and chocolate-flavored summer lineup; the S'mores Frappuccino returns after a six-year absence.

$12.99 single-serve bucket with 3 Original Recipe tenders, 5 nuggets, fries, a drink, and 3 sauces.
Signature Lemonade infused with prickly pear flavor, $3.29 medium; superseded by Tropical Passionfruit Lemonade.
Cold-brewed coffee with sweet cream, available plain/unsweetened or in Vanilla, Mocha, or Caramel; the same 3 flavors can also be added to existing Iced Coffee.
Three pink drinks — Candy Pink Lemonade Refresher, Vanilla Pink Cloud Latte, and Pink Lemon Drop Suncloud Lemonade.
Unglazed shell doughnut filled with cheesecake Kreme, dipped in maple icing, topped with graham crunch and maple drizzle; part of the Autumn Seasonal Collection.
Original Glazed doughnut dipped in chocolate icing, topped with coffee buttercream swirl and a mocha bean; part of the Autumn Seasonal Collection.
Latte with apple crisp syrup, whipped cream, caramel drizzle and graham topping; part of the Autumn Seasonal Collection.
Jr Double Cheeseburger, All-American Hot Dog, Medium Onion Rings, and Red White & Blue Slush Float all at $2.50, tied to July 4th/America's 250th.
$7.99 value box: choice of sandwich plus Curly Fries, Mozzarella Sticks, Peach Cobbler Roll and a drink.
Roast beef with melted provolone, caramelized onions, garlic aioli and steak seasoning on a sub roll, served with au jus.

Bite-sized breaded steak pieces, relaunching Aug 24, 2026 with an updated cut and a brand-new Horsey Ranch dipping sauce (a mashup of Horsey Sauce and Ranch); available in 5-count (~$5.49), 9-count (~$9.49), and a digital-only 20-count party pack with two large fries.

items.item: Matcha Beverage Platform (Matcha Iced Latte, Oreo Matcha Shake)
items.description: First nationwide QSR matcha beverage lineup.

items.item: Protein Bowls (Teriyaki & Fajita) and 2-for-$6 Jack Wraps
items.description: Chicken/rice protein bowls with up to 35g protein, from $7.69, plus a 2-for-$6 Jack Wraps deal.
One entree plus 2 sides (including breakfast items) and a drink for $5, available 24/7.
Hot Ones Sriracha Curly Fry Burger, Sauced & Loaded Fries and more, in partnership with Hot Ones.
Thin, hand-battered all-white-breast-meat chicken strips, thinner and crispier than tenders, served with dip; $4.99.
Seven new-market restaurant openings (including first stores in Rocky Mount, NC and Statesboro, GA) plus 4 remodeled reopenings, marking 30 years since the Aug 28, 1996 founding.
Returning butterflied fried shrimp platform (Southern Fried Shrimp Meal, ZaxSeas Surf & Turf Meal) with Zaxtail Sauce, plus Giant Quesadillas.
Digital-menu collab with five U.S. athletes bringing their go-to orders to the app, plus gold-foil-wrapped burritos and an 'Unwrapped' video series.
Espresso steamed with pumpkin and cinnamon flavored syrup, served hot or iced; returns alongside the Pumpkin & Creme Pie at participating restaurants nationwide starting Aug 29.

items.item: Spicy Chicken McNuggets & Mighty Hot Sauce (leaked, unconfirmed)
items.description: Reddish cayenne/chili-coated Spicy Chicken McNuggets with the fan-favorite Mighty Hot Sauce (last seen in 2021), officially confirmed and launched Feb 1, 2026, sold through early April 2026. Not actually a 2026 leak - was a real, already-completed official promo.

items.item: Watermelon Drinks Trio (Watermelon Lemonade, Watermelon Sprite, Watermelon Sparkling Energy)
items.description: Spring/summer beverage lineup: Watermelon Lemonade (Dave's Craft Lemonade with watermelon puree), Sprite Watermelon, and Watermelon Sparkling Energy (80-120mg caffeine); launched nationwide April 27, 2026 and reported still on menus as of early August.

Value bundle (choice of Whopper Jr., Bacon Cheeseburger, or Chicken Jr., plus fries, 4-pc nuggets and a drink) for $5; Restaurant Brands International said on its Aug 8 earnings call that the deal performed well enough to be extended through October 7, 2026.

items.item: National Taco Day / October Tuesday Drops
items.description: Month-long Taco Tuesday celebration kicking off on National Taco Day's new date, Tuesday Oct. 6, 2026: an exclusive T-shirt drop (500 available) at noon ET, followed by $1 Cantina Chicken Soft Taco drops every two hours (25,000 available per drop) via the Taco Bell Rewards app, capped off with 100 winners receiving a year of free Taco Tuesdays ($160 gift cards). Exclusive Tuesday Drops continue weekly through the rest of October.

New tiered value-meal lineup: $7 Box Feast (1 KFC Snacker, 5pc nuggets, fries, medium drink), $9 Box Feast (2 KFC Snackers, 5pc nuggets, fries, medium drink), and $11 Box Feast (1 chicken sandwich, 2 tenders, fries, medium drink). Still listed as available in August 2026 coverage.

New daily value promo, 2-5pm: corn dogs, a 2-piece order of mozzarella sticks, or a Soft Pretzel Twist for $1 each. No app, coupon, or loyalty signup required. Ran Aug 4-31, 2025; no 2026 repeat found as of this check.

items.item: Weekly Value Days: 99c Monday Slushes & Thursday BOGO Footlong Coney
items.description: Companion promos to Snacky Hour: medium slushes for 99 cents every Monday, and a buy-one-get-one-free Footlong Quarter Pound Coney every Thursday. Ran Aug 4-Dec 31, 2025; current 2026 weekly deals have a different structure.

SONIC Rewards members can get one free burger with the purchase of a burger of equal or greater value, redeemable once per week through August 30, 2026 via online or SONIC App orders. Excludes Triple SONIC Smashers.

Returning potato wedges in three varieties: Plain, Classic Sauced & Loaded (cheddar, cheese sauce, ranch, bacon), and a new Spicy Sauced & Loaded variety (cheddar, cheese sauce, bacon, Spicy Good Good Sauce, jalapeños); nationwide return confirmed around Aug 7, 2026.

items.item: 2 Tacos for 75 Cents (First Tuesday Monthly, 75th Anniversary)
items.description: Recurring 75th-anniversary value promo exclusive to the Jack app: 2 classic tacos for 75 cents with a $1+ purchase, offered on the first Tuesday of every month throughout 2026 (launched Jan 6, 2026; most recent occurrence Aug 4, 2026; next Sept 1, 2026).

items.item: Honey BBQ Chicken Sandwich & Honey BBQ Bacon + Cheese Sandwich
items.description: New limited-time sandwiches launched nationwide May 4, 2026: a Louisiana herb-and-spice marinated chicken breast filet with Honey BBQ sauce, pickles and a toasted brioche bun ($5.49), plus a Bacon + Cheese version adding bacon and Havarti cheese ($6.99). Still appearing on Popeyes menu pricing sites as of August 2026; no official end date announced.

items.item: $7 Meal Deal with Blizzard Treat Upgrade Option
items.description: Official DQ newsroom announcement of a new $7 value meal deal with an option to upgrade the meal to include a Blizzard Treat.

Large two-topping carryout pizzas (Hand Tossed, Crunchy Thin, or New York Style crust) for $6.99 each, valid in-store carryout only. This Super Bowl-themed iteration ran Jan 26-Feb 1, 2026; no later 2026 iteration of this specific deal found.

12-inch chocolate cookie studded with Oreo cookie pieces and topped with vanilla cream, part of Subway's Footlong Sidekicks collection; reported as returning to Subway's lineup nationwide for a limited time around May 2026.

Domino's first-ever pizza shaped like its own logo: a rectangular, single-serve Detroit-style pizza with buttery Parmesan-crusted pan dough, cut into two slices, two layers of cheese, choice of sauce, up to three toppings, and a garlic-seasoning drizzle. Sold individually (suggested ~$7.99 one-topping) or as part of the Mix & Match Deal (2+ items for $6.99 each). Announced Aug 11, 2026; launches nationwide Aug 31, 2026.

Strawberry-flavored pink Refresher collab with clothing brand Parke: triple strawberry flavors (including Strawberry Dragonfruit and a strawberry flavor shot) with oatmilk, topped with pink Strawberry Cold Foam. Launched nationwide July 17, 2026 alongside a limited-edition Parke x Dunkin' apparel/tumbler collection; no official end date announced.

Small market test of handcrafted sparkling beverages in about 100 coffeehouses across Austin, San Antonio, and St. Louis, beginning July 28, 2026. Two lines: Sparkling Refreshers (e.g. Super Mango Energy Refresher, Sparkling Strawberry Acai Lemonade Energy Refresher) and Spritzes (Sparkling Cold Brew Sour Spritz, Strawberry Sunset Spritz, Golden Peach Spritz, Strawberry Matcha Spritz). Testing customer demand ahead of a possible wider rollout; no confirmed nationwide date or end date.

items.item: Garlic Parmesan Ranch Crispy Tender Wrap
items.description: All-white-meat crispy chicken tender with melty cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and garlic parmesan ranch sauce in a soft flour tortilla; added to Sonic's $1.99 Menu alongside the Cheesy Baja Crispy Tender Wrap, Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, Vanilla Soft Serve Cup, and Small Root Beer Float.

Upcoming addition to Sonic's $1.99 Menu: all-white-meat crispy chicken tender with lettuce, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, and Sonic's BBQ Ranch sauce in a soft flour tortilla, reportedly set to join the $1.99 lineup starting September 1, 2026.

Original Chicken Sandwich lineup expansion: long white-meat chicken patty topped with creamy jalapeño sauce, crispy fried jalapeños, pickled jalapeños, fried onions, lettuce, tomato and American cheese on an oblong sesame seed bun. Joined the menu July 7, 2026 for a limited time; no announced end date.

Original Chicken Sandwich lineup expansion: the same long white-meat chicken patty and bun, built club-style with bacon, melted Swiss cheese, tomato, lettuce and mayonnaise. Joined the menu July 7, 2026 for a limited time; no announced end date.

New baked graham cracker lava cake dessert with a chocolate chip and gooey marshmallow-flavored filling, dusted with powdered sugar; sold 3 per order. Rewards members got early access July 20; rolled out nationwide July 27, 2026.

First-ever anime collab, with Toei Animation's One Piece: Luffy Bento Box ($7.99, 2pc chicken + Mac & Cheese), Luffy Bento Bundle ($13.99, adds Gum-Gum Fruit Lemonade + Chopper's Cupcake), plus a collectibles drop. Launched Apr 13, 2026; no official end date announced, though given the months elapsed it may have quietly wound down at store level.

items.item: Build Your Own Chicken Tender Tower Meal Deal
items.description: Tie-in to the Surf Lodge Hamptons partnership: 11 hand-battered chicken tenders, one large side, and four biscuits for $20 in-restaurant / $25 via DoorDash/Uber Eats. Ran as a July value promo; window has closed. Kept for the record.

items.item: Giant Chicken Finger Wraps (Chicken Bacon Ranch, Buffalo Blue, Asian Zensation)
items.description: Full-meal wraps launched nationwide in three flavors (Chicken Bacon Ranch, Buffalo Blue, and returning Asian Zensation). Superseded about two and a half months later by the newer Chicken Bacon Ranch lineup (wrap/quesadilla/loaded fries) already tracked. Kept for the record.

Crunchy taco shell dusted with Tajín, filled with seasoned beef, Spicy Ranch sauce, lettuce, shredded cheese and mango salsa, plus an extra Tajín packet. Part of a new nationwide collab with Tajín and Peso Pluma, launched Aug 13, 2026.
Gordita Crunch reworked with Tajín Clásico seasoning and extra cheese on a flatbread shell; part of the Tajín x Peso Pluma collab launched nationwide Aug 13, 2026.
Frozen pineapple-strawberry Freeze finished with Tajín seasoning for a sweet-tangy-spicy kick; part of the Tajín x Peso Pluma collab launched nationwide Aug 13, 2026.

items.item: Tajín x Taco Bell Bag Charm Collection (Tuesday Drop)
items.description: Ultra-limited merch drop (only 400 sets) tied to the Tajín/Peso Pluma collab: mini Taco Bell bag holding hot sauce/Tajín packets, a beaded Tajín-bottle holder, and a Peso Pluma heart charm; drops via the app's Tuesday Drops feature.
One-day Tuesday Drop app deal: $1 Quesarito, 8AM-11:59PM PT at participating locations nationwide. Ran Aug 11, 2026; kept for the record.

Spring 2026 LTO burger with jalapeño ranch sauce and sliced jalapeños; launched alongside a jalapeño-themed breakfast lineup on Apr 27, 2026. Previously missed from tracking; appears to still be running.

Buttery biscuit with fresh-cracked egg, sausage or bacon, American cheese and sliced jalapeños. Part of the Apr 27, 2026 jalapeño spring menu, launched the same day as the already-tracked Watermelon Drinks Trio.
Seasoned breakfast potatoes topped with sliced jalapeños, Applewood bacon and Swiss cheese sauce; part of the Apr 27, 2026 jalapeño spring lineup.

Cookie-dough flavored Frosty Fusion launched as part of the same Apr 27, 2026 spring rollout that introduced the jalapeño items; predates the currently-tracked Apple Crumble Frosty Fusion, which may have since replaced it on menus.
Buy-one-get-one-free promotion on KFC's Popcorn Chicken Big Box combo (bite-sized popcorn chicken, side, biscuit, drink), tied to the returning Popcorn Chicken item.

Chicken filet (original, spicy, or grilled) with three strips of applewood smoked bacon and honey butter spread between two maple-flavored waffles, served with syrup; smaller breakfast version until 10:30am, full entree size afterward. Nationwide rollout after a 2025 regional test.

Hand-spun milkshake with chocolate shortbread and graham cracker crumbles, marshmallow-flavored syrup, and marshmallow whipped topping; previously tested in Austin, TX in late 2025, now rolling out nationwide.
Frosted coffee beverage in s'mores flavor, launching alongside the S'mores Milkshake and Chicken & Waffles Sandwich as part of the fall 2026 nationwide rollout.
Returning fall favorite cake doughnut with pumpkin spice flavor, part of the Autumn Seasonal Collection alongside the new Maple Cheesecake and Cafe Mocha doughnuts. Runs through Nov 2, 2026.
Fan-favorite returning doughnut combining cookie butter filling with Biscoff topping, part of the Autumn Seasonal Collection. Runs through Nov 2, 2026.

Returning seasonal latte with pumpkin pie flavor blended into espresso and steamed milk, topped with whipped cream and pumpkin spice seasoning; part of the Autumn Seasonal Collection alongside the new Apple Crisp Latte. Runs through Nov 2, 2026.

Limited-edition $25 clear glass collectible cup styled as a tongue-in-cheek parody of Starbucks' viral 'Bearista' cup, featuring Jack's smile and mini yellow hat; purchase included a BOGO Coca-Cola fountain drink offer redeemable via the Jack App. Went viral after Jack in the Box tagged Starbucks in the reveal post.

items.item: Spicy Orange Crispy Chicken Wrap (regional test)
items.description: Regional test item spotted in select markets as part of Jack in the Box's protein bowl/wrap lineup expansion — a spicy-orange-sauced crispy chicken wrap alongside existing Teriyaki and Baja Ranch flavors. Not yet confirmed for nationwide rollout.

items.item: Hello Kitty & Friends x Godzilla Happy Meal
items.description: Collectible Happy Meal collab pairing Sanrio's Hello Kitty & Friends characters with Godzilla kaiju: Hello Kitty x Godzilla, Kuromi x Mechagodzilla, Pompompurin x Gigan, Cinnamoroll x Destoroyah, Chococat x SpaceGodzilla, Keroppi x King Ghidorah, My Melody x Mothra, and Badtz-Maru x Rodan (8 toys total). First-ever US Sanrio x Godzilla partnership; nationwide at participating restaurants.

Ongoing value promo: pick 2 items for $5 (Duo) or 3 items for $7 (Trio) from Whopper Jr., Original Chicken Sandwich, Bacon Cheeseburger, medium fries, 8-pc Chicken Fries, or a medium drink; dine-in/drive-thru/app/online only, not valid for delivery.
Seasonal beverage combining lemonade and freshly-brewed sweetened iced tea with white peach flavor; part of the summer 2026 peach lineup alongside the Peach Milkshake and Peach Frosted Lemonade.
Returning fall bakery item: spiced pumpkin muffin with a sweet cream cheese filling, topped with spiced pepitas; part of the fall 2026 menu launch alongside PSL and Chaider.
One-day Dunkin' Rewards promo code (FRSHDROP2) redeemable in-app for a free medium Refresher, first-come first-served up to 1 million redemptions.

Limited-time collection celebrating 30 years of Pokémon: Bulbasaur (Original Glazed, vanilla icing), Charmander (chocolate/toasted marshmallow filling, orange caramel icing), Squirtle (Original Glazed, cotton candy buttercreme), Pikachu (lemon-filled, vanilla icing, lightning nonpareils), Jigglypuff (Original Glazed, strawberry buttercream), plus a bonus Poké Ball doughnut. Includes 5 exclusive Pokémon cups filled with Original Glazed Gold Dots and a Pokémon-themed dozen box. Fans wearing Pokémon attire on Sat., Aug. 22 get one free Original Glazed doughnut.
New bowl: crispy potatoes topped with melty cheese and Arby's Steak Nuggets; priced around $9.99 (varies by market). Part of the Aug 24, 2026 Steak Nuggets relaunch.

New bowl: creamy white cheddar mac and cheese topped with Arby's Steak Nuggets and a sprinkle of crispy onions; priced around $9.99 (varies by market). Part of the Aug 24, 2026 Steak Nuggets relaunch.

Chipotle's relaunched digital-exclusive 'Build-Your-Own Chipotle' family meal (feeds 4-6: one protein, one rice, one bean, one premium side, three salsas/toppings, shredded romaine and cheese, two bags of chips, eight soft tortillas, utensils/bowls), ready for pickup in as little as 15 minutes. Available via app/chipotle.com starting Aug 26, 2026, with $10 off using code TRYBYOC through Oct 21, 2026 or until 500,000 redemptions, whichever comes first.

Decades-old original deep-fried apple pie (retired in the '90s in favor of the baked version) returned nationwide at participating restaurants as a limited-time item tied to America's 250th birthday celebrations.
Vanilla soft serve blended with crispy cereal mix and chocolatey peanut butter cookie pieces; launched nationwide for a limited time.
Hot latte, iced latte, Frappé and iced coffee variants featuring caramel apple pie flavor; officially confirmed for nationwide launch Aug 17, 2026 (some locations soft-launched Aug 13).

Vanilla soft serve with caramel drizzle and Chips Ahoy! cookie pieces, widely reported to launch September 16, 2026 alongside the rumored Spicy Chicken McNuggets/Mighty Hot Sauce return; unconfirmed and possibly recycled 2020 coverage.
Value menu platform with $4 Biggie Bites, $6 Biggie Bag (sandwich + 4pc nuggets + Jr. fry + small drink), and $8 Biggie Bundle.

Cult-favorite item brought back after roughly a decade off the menu: flour tortilla stuffed with seasoned beef, refried beans and diced onions, covered in red sauce and melted cheese, $3.99. Capped off with a $1 Enchirito one-day promo on its last day before leaving the menu again.
Three warm, crispy mini churros with a sweet cream filling, dusted in cinnamon sugar; $1.99.
Snackable chicken spin on the Crunchwrap Supreme: Crispy Chicken Nuggets, three-cheese blend, pico de gallo, and Creamy Chipotle or Jalapeño Honey Mustard sauce, grilled in a folded tortilla; $2.49.

Return of Chipotle's interactive trivia experience for Chipotle Rewards members, offering more than $1 million in free Chipotle: hourly prizes for the first 8,000 players scoring 5/5, a Silver Ticket Sweepstakes (53 winners get free burritos for a year), and a limited-edition collectible card game.

One of Chipotle's most-requested items, marinated with seared morita peppers, ground achiote, a splash of pineapple, fresh lime and hand-chopped cilantro; returned to kick off 2026 menu innovation, then left the rotation to make room for the returning Chipotle Honey Chicken.

items.item: Power Up at Chipotle ($2.50 Taco Happy Hour test, ended)
items.description: Afternoon pricing test: any single taco with any protein for $2.50, in-restaurant only, 2-5pm local time Monday-Friday, at test-market locations in Kansas City MO, Orlando FL, and Tampa FL.
Value combo: 6-inch sub, chips or two cookies, and a small fountain drink for $6.99, with a $3 upgrade to make it a Footlong Meal.

items.item: BOGO Footlong for Sub Club/Rewards Members
items.description: Targeted app/rewards offer: eligible Subway Sub Club members buy one footlong and get a second of equal or lesser value free, via the Subway app or Subway.com. Distinct from the earlier nationwide FLBOGO code promo.
One-day-only birthday promo: get an Original Glazed dozen for 89 cents with the purchase of any dozen at regular price, celebrating Krispy Kreme's 89th anniversary.
Limited-time (four days only) Original Glazed doughnut made with blueberry-flavored dough, sold individually or by the dozen; dozen available for $5 with purchase of any regular-priced dozen.

Mix-and-match value deal: choice of any two of Sonic Cheeseburger, Classic Crispy Chicken Sandwich, 6-piece Mozzarella Sticks, or Footlong Quarter Pound Coney for $7 total via the Sonic app/drive-thru at participating locations.

items.item: McValue Under $3 Menu & $4 Breakfast Meal Deal
items.description: Nationwide value platform: an Under $3 Menu (Sausage McMuffin, Sausage Biscuit, Sausage Burrito, Hash Browns, or medium McCafé coffee for breakfast; McChicken, McDouble, 4-pc Chicken McNuggets, small fries, or medium soft drink for lunch/dinner) plus a $4 Breakfast Meal Deal (Sausage McMuffin or Sausage Biscuit with hash browns and a small McCafé coffee). Launched nationwide and still running as of mid-August 2026.

MyMcDonald's Rewards app members can add a free medium fries with any $1+ qualifying purchase every Friday, once per account per week; runs continuously rather than for a fixed window. Ran weekly from Oct 2023, ended 2025, briefly revived for two weeks in Jan 2026.

Leaked-image reports point to a Dragon Ball Super tie-in expected in early September 2026 — not yet confirmed by Burger King. Rumored elements include a Super Saiyan Sauce, a Goku collectible cup, a new soft drink, Dragon Ball-themed paper crowns, and kids'-meal toys (Base Goku, Super Saiyan God Goku, Base Vegeta, Super Saiyan Vegeta, Piccolo, Beerus).
New limited-time sauce made fresh daily with cilantro, lime, Mexican spices, roasted jalapeños and sour cream; available across bowls, burritos, tacos and salads in the US and Canada.

items.item: PGA TOUR Hot Streak, Presented by Chipotle
items.description: Season-long promo tied to Chipotle's PGA TOUR sponsorship: during select tournament broadcasts, when a golfer hits a 'Hot Streak,' Chipotle drops a keyword via @PGATOUR social posts; texting the keyword to 888222 earns a BOGO code for a free regular entree with purchase of one at regular price. Up to 250,000 BOGO codes total; codes expire Dec 31, 2026.

Sippable, blended frozen version of Taco Bell's 'Tacolate' (choco-taco-inspired) dessert, made in collaboration with ice cream brand Salt & Straw; announced among 20+ new items at Taco Bell's 2026 Live Más Live reveal. No confirmed nationwide launch date yet.
New matcha drink named in a leaked fall 2026 menu graphic alongside the Tiramisu lineup and pumpkin drinks; no ingredient details confirmed and Dunkin' has not officially named this item.
Leaked fall 2026 energy drink made with Watermelon Lime Zero Syrup, a raspberry flavor shot, and lemonade; part of the same unconfirmed leaked menu graphic as the Tiramisu and pumpkin drink lineups.

items.item: Golden Fan Cup Sweepstakes & Classic Cups (Newstalgia campaign)
items.description: Year-long 80th-anniversary 'Newstalgia' celebration: $3.99 retro-design Classic Cups (four rotating archive styles) sold nationwide; one includes a hidden Golden Fan Cup card good for free Chick-fil-A for a year (52 entrées) for 3,000 winners.

items.item: Chicken Wraps Blackened Ranch Flavor & Wraps Bundle
items.description: New Blackened Ranch flavor added to Popeyes' Chicken Wraps lineup (hand-breaded tender, lettuce, shredded cheese, pickles, sauce in a buttermilk tortilla, $3.99 each), alongside a $9.99 Wraps Bundle (two wraps + a premium lemonade or tea) at participating restaurants through Dec 31, 2026.

KFC brought back its viral Fried Pickles (8-piece order) nationwide for a limited summer run, alongside a new KFC Rewards-exclusive digital deal: 5 chicken tenders plus two dipping sauces for $5, ordered via KFC.com or the app. Exact end date not confirmed in coverage found.

KFC Rewards-exclusive digital deal: two pieces of fried chicken (leg and thigh), five nuggets, a dipping sauce, and a medium fountain drink for $5, redeemable via KFC.com or the mobile app (up to four per order). No confirmed end date found.
Value bundle tied to the 'boy dinner' TikTok trend: 8 pieces of bone-in chicken or 8 Original Recipe tenders, 4 individual sides, 4 biscuits, and 4 sauces (with tenders) for $20, while supplies last.

'90s-era Twister wrap returned nationwide in Classic ($4.99), Spicy ($4.99), and Bacon ($5.99) varieties — two Original Recipe tenders, lettuce, tomato, and Pepper Mayo or Zinger Sauce in a flour tortilla. No official end date was ever published; given KFC's typical 4-8 week LTO cycle and the months since launch, this item has most likely already cycled off menus (not independently confirmed).

Digital-exclusive shareable side available only via KFC.com/app ahead of Super Bowl LX: a large order of seasoned potato wedges with 16oz queso dip (~$8.99), or an individual size (~$3.69). Framed explicitly as a game-day item; most likely ended shortly after the Super Bowl (not independently confirmed).

items.item: OG Hot Mess Cheeseburger & Hot Mess Munchie Meal
items.description: Fan-favorite Hot Mess Cheeseburger returning as part of the yearlong 75th-anniversary throwback rollout, also sold as a $13 Hot Mess Munchie Meal with two tacos, curly fries, and a drink. Exact current in-restaurant availability as of Aug 2026 not independently verified.
Mashup snack combining French fries and onion rings in one order, part of Jack in the Box's yearlong 75th-anniversary 'throwbacks and fan-favorite flavors' campaign. No confirmed launch date found.

New menu item from DQ's 2026 season-long partnership with the Savannah Bananas: DQ soft serve blended with real milk, banana, strawberries and chocolatey shavings, topped with whipped topping. Nationwide for the length of the 2026 Banana Ball season.

Tied to the 30th-anniversary restaurant-opening wave: at new/reopened locations, the first 100 dine-in customers to buy a combo meal receive a gift (hat or beanie) plus a 'Be Our Guest' card good for one free Box Combo on a future visit. Reported via a secondary summary; original article could not be independently verified.

items.item: Delivery Cowboys Horseback Delivery Event (Cowtown Coliseum)
items.description: One-afternoon Flavor Rodeo activation on Aug 7, 2026: two 'Delivery Cowboys' on horseback hand-delivered orders outside Fort Worth's Cowtown Coliseum to select Club Wingstop members, giving early access to Carolina Gold and Jamaican Jerk ahead of the Aug 11 nationwide rollout.

Teachers and college students get a free large 1-topping pizza with purchase of any large menu-priced pizza; eligibility verified via SheerID on Pizza Hut's dedicated back-to-school landing page. Recurring annual promo, live during the 2026 back-to-school season.

items.item: Hut Hook Up (Rewards Sign-Up Free Pizza)
items.description: Hut Rewards-exclusive offer: place a qualifying delivery or $7.99+ pre-tax carryout order (existing member, or join within 48 hours of purchase) to get a coupon for a free large 1-topping pizza delivered to the app inbox within 24-48 hours.

Medium or large pizza with up to 5 toppings on any recipe (Hand-Tossed, Original Pan, Thin 'N Crispy, or Chicago Tavern-Style) for $10, carryout orders placed online/app; Stuffed Crust upgrade +$3. Launched nationwide and still being promoted as of August 2026.

$2 one-topping Personal Pan Pizza (marinara, crispy crust) every Tuesday, carryout only, limit 4 per customer; not all locations participate. Originally launched summer 2025 and reported as extended/still running through 2026.

items.item: Vanilla Swirl & Orange Dream Crafted Sodas
items.description: New McCafé crafted soda additions launching alongside the Red Bull Dragonberry Energizer: Vanilla Swirl (cold foam over Coca-Cola/Diet Coke/Coke Zero) and Orange Dream (Fanta with vanilla and cold foam), plus reduced-sugar Diet Dr Pepper, Dr Pepper Zero Sugar and Sprite Zero Sugar.

Regional test at select Southern California locations of a revamped flame-grilled chicken lineup: three sandwiches (Classic, Spicy, Bacon & Swiss) and three wraps (Classic, Spicy, Honey Mustard), a redo of a 2024 test with a thicker, juicier chicken piece. No national rollout date confirmed. Revamped second attempt; an earlier 2024 test of near-identical items was pulled.

items.item: Pecan Cortado, Pecan Crunch Latte & Iced Pecan Crunch Latte
items.description: Returning fall favorites with nutty pecan flavor, brown-buttery notes and baking spices; part of the official Aug 25, 2026 fall menu launch alongside the Pumpkin Spice Latte and Chaider.

items.item: Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew & Pumpkin Spice Frappuccino (returning)
items.description: Returning seasonal pumpkin staples confirmed as part of the Aug 25, 2026 fall menu announcement, alongside the new Pumpkin Cream shaken espresso/chai/matcha lineup.
Icedream hand-spun with soda flavors (Coca-Cola, Dr Pepper, Sprite, Root Beer), added as a new beverage line as part of Chick-fil-A's 2026 'Newstalgia' menu innovations.

One-day promo tied to the Pokémon Doughnut Collection launch: guests who wear Pokémon-themed attire to participating shops on Sat., Aug. 22, 2026 get one free Original Glazed Doughnut (limit one, in-shop/drive-thru only).
Popeyes reintroduced its bone-in wings lineup with a new mild marinated base, positioned as a football-season relaunch. Exact pricing and flavor lineup not yet independently confirmed.

DQ Rewards app-exclusive offer reported by menu-aggregator sites: buy one Blizzard Treat, get a second free, following the Aug 3-30 Double Flip 99-cent deal. Not yet corroborated by an official DQ press release.

items.item: SpongeBob Movie Menu (Krabby Whopper, Cheesy Bacon Tots, Star-berry Shortcake Pie, Pineapple Float)
items.description: Tie-in menu for 'The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants' (in theaters Dec 19, 2025): SpongeBob's Krabby Whopper, Mr. Krabs' Cheesy Bacon Tots, Patrick's Star-berry Shortcake Pie, and Pirate's Frozen Pineapple Float, plus collectible toys and themed packaging.
Collab with Netflix's 'Wednesday' Season 2 Part 1 premiere: 10-pc nuggets, small fries, small chocolate Frosty, and two mystery dipping sauces in custom packaging.

items.item: Rick and Morty x Coca-Cola Freestyle Collab
